title: Quotes
purpose: Find laboratory-issued quotes for your client and review their prices, terms and decision status.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Sign in with an active client account. Every page, selection and action is limited to the client attached to your account, including work created by other users for the same client. Staff accounts cannot use these portal pages. Another client’s record is treated as missing.

sections.title: Which quotes appear
paragraphs: Only quotes in Issued, Being revised, Accepted or Declined state appear. Drafts and Withdrawn quotes are unavailable. The list shows the latest issued version’s frozen title, project, price and dates, even while the laboratory edits a new draft. It never reveals that draft’s changes.

sections.title: Find and arrange records
paragraphs: There is no bulk action or selection across pages. Invalid filters show errors and no rows; correct or clear them. No matches means the filters found nothing. An unfiltered empty list means no eligible records exist.

items.label: Search
items.description: Search quote number, the latest issued title and the latest issued project name. Case-insensitive partial matching trims surrounding spaces, up to 200 characters. Search and filters apply together to all eligible records.

items.label: Status
items.description: All statuses initially includes Being revised. Awaiting your decision selects Issued quotes still within validity. Accepted and Declined select those decisions. Expired selects Issued quotes whose latest issued valid-until date has passed. There is no separate Being revised filter option.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Apply search and filters and return to page 1. Current sorting and page size are kept.

items.label: Clear all
items.description: Remove search, filters, sorting and page settings and return to this list’s defaults. Removing one active filter keeps the others and returns to page 1.

items.label: Sort
items.description: Newest record numbers appear first. Select a sortable heading to change direction. Sortable columns: Quote, Title, Project, Status, Total (USD), Valid until and Issued. Sorting applies to all matches with record identity as a stable tie-breaker.

items.label: Rows per page
items.description: 25 by default; choose 50 or 100. A change returns to page 1 and preserves other query settings. Show applies the choice without automatic submission.

items.label: First page / Previous page / Next page / Last page
items.description: Move through matching records. The footer shows the visible range, count and page. Unavailable directions are disabled. Invalid page numbers resolve to an available page; unsupported page sizes are refused.

items.label: Columns
items.description: With enhanced controls, show/hide columns and use Move up / Move down or drag headings to reorder. Quote is always shown and fixed. Changes apply immediately and are saved for your account for this table. They do not filter or change records.

items.label: Reset columns / Done / Close
items.description: Reset columns restores shipped visibility and order. Done or Close dismisses the Columns dialog; changes already apply.

items.label: Quote
items.description: Assigned QT number; select to read the quote document and its issued versions.

items.label: Title
items.description: Title frozen in the latest issued version; a missing legacy title shows Title not recorded.

items.label: Project
items.description: Optional project frozen at issue; hidden initially. A dash means no project was recorded.

items.label: Status
items.description: Current quote state. Expired is calculated after the valid-until date; Being revised means no decision can be made until the next issue.

items.label: Total (USD)
items.description: Exact total of the latest issued version, including fees/discounts.

items.label: Valid until
items.description: Last date the issued version can be accepted or declined, or a dash if missing.

items.label: Issued
items.description: Issue date/time of the latest issued version; hidden initially.

sections.title: Next step
paragraphs: Open a quote number to review its full scope and terms. An empty list means there are no visible issued quotes for your client. Contact the laboratory for a quote or to reissue an expired one.
